title: OnePlus launches Ace 7 series with 185Hz screen and 9,000mAh battery
title_zh: 一加发布 Ace 7 系列：185Hz 屏幕加 9000mAh 大电池

image.credit: Photo by Badhan Ganesh on Unsplash
image.author: Badhan Ganesh

lead: OnePlus unveiled the Ace 7 and Ace 7 Pro on October 29, billing the pair as an all-round hardware upgrade that brings flagship-grade experience to its gaming-focused line. Both phones push refresh rates, battery capacity and camera hardware well beyond their predecessors.
lead_zh: 10 月 29 日，一加发布 Ace 7 与 Ace 7 Pro，称这一系列经过全方位硬件升级，为主打电竞的产品线带来了旗舰级体验。两款机型在刷新率、电池容量和影像硬件上都较前代有明显提升。

paragraphs: The series comes in two classic shades, Midnight Black and Flowing White, alongside two new options: Breaking Wind and Quenching. The Pro's Breaking Wind finish layers textures beneath a light-blue glass back with a three-dimensional etched frost effect, while the standard model's Quenching body pairs orange with silver matte tones for a soft, fine-grained feel. Both carry IP66/68/69/69K dust and water resistance, metal frames and a distinctive camera island that also draws in more cooling air.

At the heart of the lineup sits a flagship 185Hz fourth-generation display, built on X4 emitting material co-developed with BOE. New LTPO circuitry and a hardware-level high-refresh scheme deliver 185Hz in games and 165Hz across the system without sacrificing power efficiency or longevity. Eye-care features such as hardware low blue light and 3,840Hz PWM dimming remain on board.

The two models diverge on silicon: the Pro runs the fifth-generation Snapdragon 8 Elite, the standard model a V Series chip of the same architecture. Both share a new gaming engine, a trio of dedicated gaming chips and a debut dual-channel air-cooling system. A dedicated display chip, the P4, keeps fast-moving targets sharp at 185Hz, while a G3 network chip tackles latency over Wi-Fi and cellular.

Imaging has been overhauled too, with a 200-megapixel main camera across the range and a 3.5x periscope telephoto on the Pro reaching 120x digital zoom. OPPO's flagship algorithms enable 4K Live Photos, 8K/30fps and 4K/120fps video and Log mode. Both ship with ColorOS 17, a 9,000mAh battery and 100W charging with bypass power that keeps heat down during play.

The Ace 7 Pro starts at 3,649 yuan for 12GB+256GB and tops out at 5,749 yuan for 16GB+1TB, with state subsidies shaving 500 yuan off. The Ace 7 ranges from 3,249 to 4,349 yuan. A magnetic sandstone case retails at 99 yuan, or 69 yuan bundled.
paragraphs_zh: 该系列提供极夜黑与流光白两款经典配色，另加破风、淬火两种新配色。Pro 的破风机身在浅蓝玻璃后盖上叠加纹理，做出立体冰霜蚀刻效果；标准版淬火车身则以橙色搭配银色哑光，触感细腻柔和。两款均具备 IP66/68/69/69K 防尘防水、金属中框和辨识度很高的摄像头模组，后者还能带来更大进风量。
全系核心是一块旗舰级 185Hz 第四代屏幕，采用与京东方联合定制的 X4 发光材料。全新 LTPO 电路和硬件级高刷方案让游戏达到 185Hz、系统全局 165Hz，同时兼顾低功耗与长寿命。硬件级低蓝光、3840Hz 高频 PWM 调光等护眼配置也一并保留。
两款机型在芯片上有所区分：Pro 搭载第五代骁龙 8 至尊版，标准版则采用同架构的 V Series 芯片。两者共用新一代游戏内核、电竞三芯和首发的双路冰河风冷系统。专用显示芯片 P4 让 185Hz 下高速移动的目标依旧清晰，网络芯片 G3 则针对 Wi-Fi 与蜂窝网络的延迟问题。
影像也全面升级：全系配备 2 亿像素主摄，Pro 另有 3.5 倍潜望长焦，最高支持 120 倍数码变焦。借助 OPPO 旗舰算法，可实现 4K 实况、8K/30fps 与 4K/120fps 视频以及 Log 模式。两款均搭载 ColorOS 17、9000mAh 电池和 100W 闪充，旁路供电让边玩边充也不易发烫。
价格方面，Ace 7 Pro 12GB+256GB 起售 3649 元，16GB+1TB 顶配 5749 元，国补还能再减 500 元。Ace 7 售价区间为 3249 至 4349 元。砂岩磁吸保护壳零售价 99 元，与手机同购为 69 元。
